## Risk And Approval Gates

- [ ] No secrets, real `.env*`, keys, tokens, passwords, or secret storage changed.
- [ ] No deployment, Docker, server scripts, production operations, bind addresses, or public admin exposure changed.
- [ ] No payments, pricing, billing, refunds, paid jobs, payment UI, or provider/payment policy changed.
- [ ] No auth, security, RBAC, sessions, admin access, telemetry, or redaction boundaries changed.
- [ ] No legal/privacy/AUP/refund/support text or user-data handling changed.
- [ ] No database schema/state, migrations, scheduler/job/work-unit state, retention, TTL, backups, restore, runtime `var/`, or destructive operations changed.
- [ ] No new production dependencies added.
- [ ] No product scope expanded beyond Telegram-first closed beta, TXT/DOCX/EPUB, or the approved MVP.
- [ ] Human approval is recorded in the linked issue/PR when any high-risk area is touched.

## Reviewer Agent Checklist

- [ ] Review starts with blockers, risks, missing evidence, and required human decisions.
- [ ] Scope matches the linked issue/task.
- [ ] Acceptance criteria are satisfied or gaps are clearly marked.
- [ ] Tests run are appropriate for the changed area, or missing verification is explained.
- [ ] Docs impact is handled or explicitly not needed.
- [ ] No raw document text, prompts, translations, API keys, secrets, provider internals, unsafe stack traces, or unsafe user data appear in logs, admin views, telemetry, docs, or artifacts.
- [ ] Rights confirmation, beta allowlist, cost caps, kill switch, SSH-tunnel-only admin, and payment/public-production gates are not weakened.
- [ ] If CI is absent or Unknown, local verification evidence is recorded instead of claiming CI passed.
